keySentence: The animals promised to help each other.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pip raised his small head. "Each other," he said clearly. "Not one alone. Together." The friends moved closer. Five hooves and wings met in the middle. A soft wind blew gently. The promise felt real and true. The animals promised to help each other.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: "Each other," Pip said firmly, adding the most important word of all. "Not just sometimes. Not just when it is easy. If anyone is hurting, we do not wait. We do not look away. We help." The friends looked at each other with shining eyes. Slowly, they placed their hooves and wings together in the very center of their circle. Five small parts joined to make one strong promise. A soft breeze moved gently through the yard, as if the world itself had heard them and was nodding back. Even the old apple tree seemed to lean in. The animals promised to help each other, and their friendship became a kind of family that nothing could break.
